name: Seven Card Stud Poker
summary: Classic poker variant where each player makes the best five-card hand from seven cards to win the pot.
rules_text: Each player is dealt two cards face-down and one face-up in rotation from a standard 52-card deck. A betting round follows. Then each active player receives three more face-up cards one at a time, each followed by a betting round, and finally one face-down card followed by a final betting round. Players may fold. At showdown, remaining players reveal their hole cards and choose exactly five of their seven cards to form a poker hand, discarding the other two which cannot be recovered. Standard poker rankings apply from high card to straight flush, with five of a kind possible only with wild cards. Highest five-card hand wins the pot containing all bets.
